protocol: Frozen Binance USDT perpetual NY Monday first pure wick cohort, including delisted; same 1h then 4h then 12h priority. Each timeframe is fit separately.
target: long takes Monday low, short takes Monday high; skip if target at or behind actual next H1 opening fill. Eligibility is decided before exposing the account to the trade.
stop: Original signal wick extreme extended 1% outward. Stop and TP live from entry, orders may persist across weeks, independent equal initial risk per event.
candidate_detail: Standardized logistic regression; LightGBM d3/150 trees and d5/240 trees, frozen original hyperparameters. Shared expanded close-time features plus potential near-edge net R computed using the signal close as the decision-time entry proxy.
label_design: At each fit, take the 90th percentile of that timeframe's net R for events settled and known by the cut. Label equal or above and strictly positive as winners. All other settled eligible trades are negatives; censor unresolved labels. Freeze that R cutoff for the following evaluation interval.
selection: Rank configurations by equal-weight mean of 2023/24/25 forward high-band mean realized net R. For each model/fold use its own training score 90th percentile to define high. Freeze final scores/thresholds before 2026 test; 2026 has been viewed in the older 3R study. Assess against all eligible, mechanism-only predicted near net R and same-week/side/timeframe equal count random draws.
